```yaml
name: PR Issue Link Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  check-issue-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for issue link in PR title or body
        id: check-link
        run: |
          # Define patterns for issue linking
          # Matches: Fixes #123, Closes #456, Resolves #789, #123, etc.
          PATTERN='(#|Fixes|Closes|Resolves|Fix|Close|Resolve)[[:space:]]*#[0-9]+'
          
          # Get PR title and body from environment variables to avoid injection
          TITLE="${PR_TITLE}"
          BODY="${PR_BODY}"
          
          # Combine title and body for checking
          CONTENT="${TITLE} ${BODY}"
          
          # Check if pattern exists
          if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qEi "$PATTERN"; then
            echo "Issue link found."
            echo "has_link=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "No issue link found."
            echo "has_link=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}

      - name: Validate issue existence
        if: steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'true'
        id: validate-issue
        run: |
          # Extract issue numbers from the content
          TITLE="${PR_TITLE}"
          BODY="${PR_BODY}"
          CONTENT="${TITLE} ${BODY}"
          
          # Extract all issue numbers
          ISSUES=$(echo "$CONTENT" | grep -oE '#[0-9]+' | sort -u)
          
          VALID=true
          INVALID_ISSUES=""
          
          for ISSUE in $ISSUES; do
            # Remove the # symbol
            ISSUE_NUM=${ISSUE#\#}
            
            # Check if issue exists using GitHub API
            # We use curl to check if the issue exists
            RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${ISSUE_NUM}")
            
            if [ "$RESPONSE" -ne 200 ]; then
              VALID=false
              INVALID_ISSUES="${INVALID_ISSUES} Issue #${ISSUE_NUM} does not exist or is not accessible.\n"
            fi
          done
          
          if [ "$VALID" = true ]; then
            echo "All referenced issues are valid."
            echo "valid=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Some referenced issues are invalid."
            echo "valid=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "invalid_issues=$INVALID_ISSUES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}

      - name: Comment on PR if no link found
        if: steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'false'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ⚠️ **Missing Issue Link**
            
            This pull request does not contain a link to a valid issue. Please update the PR title or description to include a reference to the related issue.
            
            Acceptable formats:
            - `Fixes #123`
            - `Closes #456`
            - `Resolves #789`
            - `#123`
            
            This requirement helps maintain traceability between code changes and project issues.
          comment-tag: "issue-link-check"
          mode: upsert

      - name: Comment on PR if invalid issue found
        if: steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'true' && steps.validate-issue.outputs.valid == 'false'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ⚠️ **Invalid Issue Reference**
            
            One or more issues referenced in this pull request do not exist or are not accessible:
            
            ${{ steps.validate-issue.outputs.invalid_issues }}
            
            Please ensure that all referenced issues exist in this repository.
          comment-tag: "issue-link-check"
          mode: upsert

      - name: Remove comment if valid
        if: steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'true' && steps.validate-issue.outputs.valid == 'true'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          comment-tag: "issue-link-check"
          mode: delete

      - name: Fail if no valid link
        if: steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'false' || (steps.check-link.outputs.has_link == 'true' && steps.validate-issue.outputs.valid == 'false')
        run: exit 1
```
